A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Deep Signature research. All 19 pages in each, including equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–C, support reliable comparison through text extraction and visual inspection.

before.justification: v2 reports original classification experiments on gene regulatory, EGFR and GPCR dynamics, with scalability studies, ablations and additional sensitivity results in Appendix C.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results in Section 4 and Appendix C, including classification comparisons and component and parameter analyses.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same spectral clustering, log-signature transform, LSTM and classifier, with unchanged clustering, temporal consistency and classification losses. The architectures in Appendix B also match.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same gene regulatory classification, EGFR drug-sensitivity prediction and GPCR state classification tasks. Figure 4 retains the same trajectory-duration and system-size coverage.

E2.justification: Figure 4 removes GraphTrans from both scalability comparisons, retaining Head, Tail, Head & Tail and GraphLSTM against Deep Signature. GraphTrans remains in Tables 1, 2 and 4; their comparator membership is unchanged.

E3.justification: The temporal five-fold validation procedure, independent testing, dataset sizes, model configurations, training settings and evaluation metrics remain unchanged in Sections 3.4–4 and Appendix B. Expressing recall as percentages does not change the metric.

E4.justification: The scalability analysis in Figure 4 loses GraphTrans evidence concerning sensitivity to trajectory duration and system size. The loss ablation, structural and feature analyses, interpretability examples and Appendix C parameter-sensitivity analyses remain unchanged.

E5.justification: The five-run averaging statement, repeated validation procedure and tabulated plus/minus uncertainty reporting are unchanged. Neither version adds different seed information, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Section 4.2 corrects EGFR recall from 0.220 to 21.27%. Section 4.3 corrects Deep Signature's GPCR accuracy/recall from 64.200%/0.413 to 58.00%/43.30%, and GraphLSTM's from 53.333%/0.360 to 53.47%/38.13%. These changes align the prose with unchanged Tables 2 and 4, rather than documenting new performance outcomes. Figure 4 also removes GraphTrans results; retained curves and table values are unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and derivations in Section 3 and the translation, rotation, permutation and time-reparameterization arguments in Appendix A are unchanged, including Theorem 1.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning efficient dynamics characterization, symmetry properties and superior performance on three benchmarks.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning class imbalance, nonlinear dynamics, feature generalization, structural fidelity and interpretability remain unchanged. Appendix C retains the same qualifications about extreme coarsening levels and loss weights.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility information in Section 3.4 and Appendix B is unchanged, including pooling sizes, hidden dimensions, optimizers, batch sizes, simulation settings and software references. Code and data access information also matches.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works and positioning relative to molecular representations, coarse-graining methods and previous signature-based approaches are unchanged.

P1.justification: Edits are limited to numerical presentation and nearby wording in Sections 4.2–4.3, including percentage-form recall and consistent two-decimal accuracy formatting. The arXiv version/date stamp changes; section organization and the surrounding narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 4 is redrawn without GraphTrans curves or legend entries, adds horizontal-axis labels T and N, and makes small sizing and styling adjustments. Other figures and table structures remain unchanged, with only local text reflow.

improvement.justification: v3 resolves text–table contradictions in Sections 4.2–4.3, particularly the GPCR accuracy reported as 64.200% despite Table 4 showing 58.00%. This improves reporting reliability. Removing GraphTrans from Figure 4 reduces the completeness of scalability comparisons, but its main benchmark results remain available; the numerical corrections provide a modest net improvement.
